data.title: 橘美花莉 · 摄影棚收工的三秒
data.description: 摄影棚白色背景前，闪光灯刚停，她从完美表情切换到松一口气的真实脸只用三秒；工作人员围着看片，她独自拿起水杯，眼神飘向手机里的社团群消息。
data.action: 摄影棚白色背景前，闪光灯刚停，她从完美表情切换到松一口气的真实脸只用三秒
data.promptProse: Mikari Tachibana drops her flawless camera expression into a relieved breath as the studio flash stops. She picks up water in her white off-shoulder top and pink skirt while glancing at the club's messages on her phone. The medium portrait includes the white backdrop and staff reviewing pictures farther behind. Studio stands provide even light on her chestnut hair and cup, with softer shadows separating the background crew from the backdrop.
